'''''House of Gucci''''' is a 2021 American [[Biographical film|biographical]] [[crime drama]] film directed by [[Ridley Scott]], based on the 2001 book ''The House of Gucci: A Sensational Story of Murder, Madness, Glamour, and Greed'' by Sara Gay Forden. 

The film follows [[Patrizia Reggiani]] ([[Lady Gaga]]) and [[Maurizio Gucci]] ([[Adam Driver]]) as their romance transforms into a fight for control of the Italian fashion brand [[Gucci]]. [[Jared Leto]], [[Jeremy Irons]], [[Jack Huston]], [[Salma Hayek]] and [[Al Pacino]] also star.

Scott wanted to make a film about the Gucci dynasty after acquiring rights to Forden's book in the early 2000s. The project languished for several years, with several directors, and actors rumored to be considered before Scott and Gaga became officially attached in November 2019. Much of the remaining cast joined the following summer, and filming began in Italy, lasting from February through May 2021.

The world premiere of ''House of Gucci'' was held at the [[Odeon Luxe Leicester Square]] in London on November 9, 2021. It was theatrically released in the United States by [[United Artists Releasing]] on November 24, 2021. The film received mixed reviews from critics, who praised the cast's performances, but criticized the inconsistent tone and editing. Gaga and Leto were nominated for the [[Screen Actors Guild Awards|Screen Actors Guild Award]], [[Critics' Choice Movie Awards|Critics' Choice Award]], and [[Satellite Awards|Satellite Award]] for Best Actress and Best Supporting Actor, respectively, while Gaga also received nominations for the [[Golden Globe Awards|Golden Globe Award]] and [[British Academy Film Awards|BAFTA Award]]. The film also earned a nomination at the [[94th Academy Awards]] for [[Academy Award for Best Makeup and Hairstyling|Best Makeup and Hairstyling]]. It grossed more than $153 million against a $75 million budget.

==Plot==
In Italy in 1978, [[Patrizia Reggiani]] is the office manager of her father's small trucking company. At a party, she meets [[Maurizio Gucci]], a law student and heir to a 50% interest in the [[Gucci]] fashion house through his father [[Rodolfo Gucci|Rodolfo]]. Patrizia aggressively pursues the awkward Maurizio, charming him into a romantic relationship.

Rodolfo warns Maurizio that Patrizia is only after his wealth, and tells Maurizio that he will [[Inheritance|disinherit]] him if he marries Patrizia. Maurizio chooses Patrizia over his connection to Gucci, leaving the family. Patrizia and Maurizio marry, and he is hired by her father's trucking company.

When Patrizia becomes pregnant, she considers her child to be an avenue for familial reconciliation, and lets that information slip to Maurizio's uncle [[Aldo Gucci|Aldo]], who is delighted and takes the couple under his wing.

Aldo introduces Patrizia to his eccentric son [[Paolo Gucci|Paolo]], who aspires to be a designer within Gucci despite his apparent lack of talent. Aldo helps Maurizio, and a terminally ill Rodolfo, reconcile shortly before the latter's death. Rodolfo returns Maurizio to his will, but, before he dies, fails to sign the document bequeathing to him the 50% interest in Gucci [[Share (finance)|shares]], so Patrizia forges Rodolfo's signature on Rodolfo's updated testament.

Patrizia devises a plot to obtain a controlling interest in Gucci by acquiring some of Aldo's and Paolo's shares (the other 50%). She clashes with Aldo over the firm's sale of cheap "fake" Gucci products on the [[black market]], and consults Giuseppina "Pina", a [[psychic]], for guidance on how to manipulate Maurizio, who has little interest in Gucci, into taking a more active role within the company.

Paolo acquires proof that Aldo has been [[evading taxes]] in the United States. He gives the information to Patrizia in exchange for her promise that he be allowed to design his own product line. Aldo is arrested by the [[IRS]] and sentenced to [[Year and a day rule|a year and a day]] in prison.

Patrizia lies to the Italian police and tells them that Paolo is not authorized to use the Gucci [[trademark]], so they stop his fashion show by force. Patrizia and Maurizio ask Paolo to sell his shares to them, but he rebuffs their effort and cuts ties with them.

Italian police search Maurizio, attempting to arrest him for forging Rodolfo's signature. He flees to Switzerland, where Maurizio meets his old friend [[Paola Franchi]]. After an argument between Maurizio and Patrizia, he is tired of his wife's influence on him and the company. He orders his wife and daughter to return to Italy, and begins an affair with Paola, which Pina senses.

When Maurizio's business plans harm the company, he seeks assistance from investment firm [[Investcorp]], through which he hatches a scheme to acquire shares of the company from a now-impoverished Paolo. Aldo returns from prison and immediately realizes what Paolo has done. When Investcorp offers to buy out Aldo, he refuses, until Maurizio reveals himself to be the deal's instigator. Dejected, Aldo sells the shares and cuts out communication with Maurizio.

Patrizia attempts a reconciliation with Maurizio, but he bluntly ignores her. He soon asks her for a divorce through his longtime assistant, [[Domenico De Sole]], a request that she refuses. Maurizio recruits up-and-coming designer [[Tom Ford]] to revitalize the company's image through a new line. His products are successful, but Maurizio has so thoroughly mismanaged the company that, by 1995, Investcorp's leaders feel compelled to buy him out, replacing him with Tom and Domenico.

Patrizia eventually grows ever more furious with Maurizio. She asks Pina for help in assassinating him. Pina puts her in contact with two hitmen. A few days later, they shoot Maurizio to death in broad daylight outside his office.

Patrizia takes her husband's last name while announcing herself in court, indicating that she still considers herself to be a Gucci, even if the law does not.

Patrizia, Pina and the hitmen are sentenced to long prison terms following their arrests for murder. Aldo dies of [[prostate cancer]] in 1990, and Paolo dies in poverty shortly following the sale of his shares to Maurizio. Gucci is fully acquired by Investcorp, and continues to be successfully managed. Ultimately, no Gucci family members remain with the company.

== Production ==
=== Development ===
[[File:NASA Journey to Mars and “The Martian” (201508180030HQ).jpg|thumb|upright|left|''House of Gucci'' director [[Ridley Scott]]|alt=refer to caption]]

In June 2006, [[Ridley Scott]] was set to direct a film for [[Paramount Pictures]] about the downfall of the Gucci family dynasty, with [[Andrea Berloff]] writing the script,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gardner |first=Chris |date=June 21, 2006 |title=Gucci bio gets going |url=https://variety.com/2006/film/features/gucci-bio-gets-going-1200337355/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20211203002553/https://variety.com/2006/film/features/gucci-bio-gets-going-1200337355/ |archive-date=December 3, 2021 |access-date=December 3, 2021 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}</ref> despite the family's dismissal of the project,<ref>{{cite web|last=Odell|first=Amy|date=November 2, 2009|title=Gucci Family Doesn't Want Ridley Scott's Gucci Movie to Happen|url=https://www.thecut.com/2009/11/gucci_family_doesnt_want_ridle.html|url-access=limited|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190505021845/https://www.thecut.com/2009/11/gucci_family_doesnt_want_ridle.html|archive-date=May 5, 2019|access-date=March 1, 2021|work=[[The Cut (website)|The Cut]]}}</ref> with [[Angelina Jolie]] and [[Leonardo DiCaprio]] rumored to play Patrizia Reggiani and Maurizio Gucci.<ref>{{cite web|last=Milligan|first=Lauren|date=18 November 2009|title=Gucci Film Confirmed|url=https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/gucci-film-confirmed-by-ridley-scott|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190505021856/https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/gucci-film-confirmed-by-ridley-scott|archive-date=May 5, 2019|access-date=March 1, 2021|work=[[British Vogue]]}}</ref> In February 2012, Scott's daughter [[Jordan Scott (filmmaker)|Jordan Scott]] had replaced him as director and was in talks with [[Penélope Cruz]] to play Reggiani.<ref>{{cite web|last=Keene|first=Allison|date=12 October 2012|title=Ridley Scott's Daughter Replaces Him as Director on Gucci; Penelope Cruz in Talks for Lead|url=https://collider.com/gucci-penelope-cruz-jordan-scott/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190421235022/https://collider.com/gucci-penelope-cruz-jordan-scott/|archive-date=April 21, 2019|access-date=March 1, 2021|work=[[Collider (website)|Collider]]}}</ref> In November 2016, [[Wong Kar-wai]] took over as director from Jordan Scott, with [[Charles Randolph]] writing alongside Berloff, and [[Margot Robbie]] now being considered to play Reggiani.<ref>{{cite web|last=Shoard|first=Catherine|date=17 November 2016|title=Wong Kar-Wai to return with Gucci murder movie|url=https://www.theguardian.com/film/2016/nov/17/wong-kar-wai-return-maurizio-gucci-fashion-murder-movie|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170301094314/https://www.theguardian.com/film/2016/nov/17/wong-kar-wai-return-maurizio-gucci-fashion-murder-movie|archive-date=March 1, 2017|access-date=March 1, 2021|work=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref> In November 2019, Ridley Scott was again set to direct the film,{{Why|date=March 2021}} with [[Roberto Bentivegna]] writing the script, and [[Lady Gaga]] set to star.<ref>{{cite web|last=Fleming|first=Mike Jr.|date=November 1, 2019|title=Lady Gaga, Ridley & Giannina Scott Team On Film About Assassination Of Gucci Grandson Maurizio; Gaga To Play Convicted Ex-Wife Patrizia Reggiani|url=https://deadline.com/2019/11/lady-gaga-ridley-scott-movie-maurizio-gucci-patrizia-reggiani-murder-gucci-family-giannina-scott-1202774518/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200904022917/https://deadline.com/2019/11/lady-gaga-ridley-scott-movie-maurizio-gucci-patrizia-reggiani-murder-gucci-family-giannina-scott-1202774518/|archive-date=September 4, 2020|access-date=March 1, 2021|work=[[Deadline Hollywood]]}}</ref> According to the Gucci [[Chief executive officer|CEO]], [[Marco Bizzarri]], the fashion house cooperated with the production and gave them full access to their archives for wardrobe and props.<ref>{{cite news|url-access=subscription|last=Zargani|first=Luisa|date=March 15, 2021|title=Marco Bizzarri on Japan, New Ginza Store and 'House of Gucci' Film|url=https://wwd.com/business-news/business-features/marco-bizzarri-japan-new-ginza-store-house-of-gucci-1234776505/|work=[[Women's Wear Daily]]|access-date=May 12, 2021|archive-date=May 12, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210512033524/https://wwd.com/business-news/business-features/marco-bizzarri-japan-new-ginza-store-house-of-gucci-1234776505/|url-status=live}}</ref>

Gaga explained that she took into account how her longtime friend Tony Bennett "feels about Italians being represented in film in terms of crime", and aspired to "make a real person out of Patrizia, not a caricature".<ref name="TWSJ">{{Cite news|last=Myers|first=Marc|date=October 1, 2021|title=For Lady Gaga, Not Even a Pandemic Will Slow Her Down|url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/for-lady-gaga-not-even-a-pandemic-will-slow-her-down-11633089601|access-date=October 16, 2021|newspaper=[[The Wall Street Journal]]|archive-date=October 1, 2021|archive-url=https://archive.today/20211001151109/https://www.wsj.com/articles/for-lady-gaga-not-even-a-pandemic-will-slow-her-down-11633089601|url-status=live}}</ref> To achieve that, she studied Reggiani's vocal cadence and attitude. She explained, "I felt the best way to honor Maurizio and Italians was for my performance to be authentic, from the perspective of a woman. Not an [[Italian Americans|Italian-American]] woman, but an Italian woman."<ref name="TWSJ"/> She stayed in character for 18 months, speaking with an accent for nine months during that period. She also ad-libbed many of her lines, including the film's iconic quote, "Father, son and House of Gucci", which went [[Viral marketing|viral]] after the release of the film's first trailer.<ref>{{cite news|last=Heritage|first=Stuart|url=https://www.theguardian.com/film/2021/nov/03/madness-in-her-method-did-lady-gaga-really-stay-in-character-for-18-months|title=Madness in her method: Did Lady Gaga really stay in character for 18 months?|newspaper=[[The Guardian]]|date=November 3, 2021|access-date=November 25, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211124144351/https://www.theguardian.com/film/2021/nov/03/madness-in-her-method-did-lady-gaga-really-stay-in-character-for-18-months|archive-date=November 24, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=November 21, 2021|title=Lady Gaga Reveals She Ad-Libbed Viral 'Father, Son, and House of Gucci' Line|first=Ryan|last=Lattanzio|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/house-of-gucci-lady-gaga-father-son-house-of-gucci-1234680766/|work=[[IndieWire]]|access-date=January 2, 2022|archive-date=December 31, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211231223220/https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/house-of-gucci-lady-gaga-father-son-house-of-gucci-1234680766/|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Filming ===
In August 2020, it was reported that filming was expected to begin when Scott completed production of ''[[The Last Duel (2021 film)|The Last Duel]]'' (2021).<ref name="MGMGucci"/> On February 3, 2021, Leto said that the film was still in the [[pre-production]] phase, and that they would start shooting in [[Italy]] in the coming weeks.<ref>{{cite news|last=Ferme|first=Antonio|date=February 3, 2021|title=Jared Leto Talks Surprise Golden Globes Nomination, 'Gucci' and Zack Snyder|url=https://variety.com/2021/film/news/jared-leto-surprise-golden-globes-nomination-gucci-zack-snyder-1234899924/|work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|access-date=March 23, 2021|archive-date=February 24, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210224070802/https://variety.com/2021/film/news/jared-leto-surprise-golden-globes-nomination-gucci-zack-snyder-1234899924/|url-status=live}}</ref> [[Principal photography]] began in [[Rome]] at the end of February, with [[COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19]] safety precautions in place.<ref name=wantedinrome>{{cite news|date=February 25, 2021|title=Lady Gaga seeks Rome base while filming Gucci movie|url=https://www.wantedinrome.com/news/lady-gaga-seeks-rome-base-while-filming-gucci-movie.html|work=[[Wanted in Rome]]|access-date=March 22, 27, 2021|access-date=March 1, 2021|publisher=[[Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata|ANSA]]}}</ref>

Several scenes were filmed in early March in the cities of [[Gressoney-Saint-Jean]] and [[Gressoney-La-Trinité]], specifically in the [[Italian Alps]] in the [[Aosta Valley]], which were used to create the tourist complex of [[St. Moritz]] in [[Switzerland]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Massimiliano|first=Riccio|date=March 9, 2021|title=Concluse le riprese del film "House of Gucci" a Gressoney, il set si sposta a Milano|url=https://aostasera.it/notizie/cultura-e-spettacolo/gucci-il-film-di-ridley-scott-con-al-pacino-e-lady-gaga-sara-girato-anche-a-gressoney/|work=AostaSera|language=it|access-date=March 22, 2021|archive-date=February 19, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210219180833/https://aostasera.it/notizie/cultura-e-spettacolo/gucci-il-film-di-ridley-scott-con-al-pacino-e-lady-gaga-sara-girato-anche-a-gressoney/|url-status=live}}</ref> Filming also took place in other locations, such as [[Florence]], [[Lake Como]] (at [[Villa del Balbiano]]) and [[Milan]],<ref name=wantedinrome/> including the [[Villa Necchi Campiglio]] (previously featured in the film ''[[I Am Love (film)|I Am Love]]''). At the end of March, filming returned to Rome to shoot scenes at [[Via Condotti]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Scicchitano|first=Flavia|date=March 23, 2021|title=Via Condotti, al via il set di House of Gucci: ciak per Al Pacino e Lady Gaga|url=https://www.leggo.it/italia/roma/lady_gaga_al_pacino_roma_house_of_gucci-5848310.html|work=[[Leggo]]|language=it|access-date=May 11, 2021|archive-date=March 24, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210324123227/https://www.leggo.it/italia/roma/lady_gaga_al_pacino_roma_house_of_gucci-5848310.html|url-status=live}}</ref> Filming wrapped on May 8.<ref>{{cite magazine|date=May 8, 2021|title=House of Gucci Has Finished Filming, Lady Gaga Confirms|url=https://www.harpersbazaar.com/celebrity/latest/a36372644/house-of-gucci-finished-filming-lady-gaga-confirms/|magazine=[[Harper's Bazaar]]|access-date=May 11, 2021|archive-date=May 12, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210512024846/https://www.harpersbazaar.com/celebrity/latest/a36372644/house-of-gucci-finished-filming-lady-gaga-confirms/|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Music===

==Release and marketing==
''House of Gucci'' had its world premiere at the [[Odeon Luxe Leicester Square]] in London on November 9, 2021. It was released theatrically in North America on November 24, 2021,<ref name="MGMGucci" /><ref>{{cite web|last=Krol|first=Charlotte|date=August 21, 2020|title=Lady Gaga's 'Gucci' movie rounds out stellar cast with Adam Driver, Robert De Niro and more|url=https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/film/lady-gagas-gucci-movie-rounds-out-stellar-cast-with-adam-driver-jared-leto-robert-de-niro-al-pacino-2735447|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210205025748/https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/film/lady-gagas-gucci-movie-rounds-out-stellar-cast-with-adam-driver-jared-leto-robert-de-niro-al-pacino-2735447|archive-date=February 5, 2021|access-date=March 1, 2021|work=[[NME]]}}</ref> and in the United Kingdom on November 26.<ref>{{cite web|last=Maitland|first=Hayley|date=March 10, 2021|title=A First Look at Lady Gaga in 'House of Gucci' (Featuring Adam Driver in Impeccable Knitwear)|url=https://www.vogue.co.uk/arts-and-lifestyle/article/lady-gaga-ridley-scott-gucci-film|access-date=March 22, 2021|work=[[British Vogue]]|archive-date=March 21, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210321032443/https://www.vogue.co.uk/arts-and-lifestyle/article/lady-gaga-ridley-scott-gucci-film|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=''House of Gucci'' / Past, Present and Future Releases|url=https://filmdistributorsassociation.com/release-schedule/past-present-and-future-releases/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210328142756/https://filmdistributorsassociation.com/release-schedule/past-present-and-future-releases/?filmSearch=House+of+Gucci|archive-date=March 28, 2021|access-date=March 28, 2021|website=Film Distributors’ Association}}</ref> Following its theatrical release, it was available to stream on [[Paramount+]].<ref>{{cite web|last=D'Alessandro|first=Anthony|date=February 24, 2021|title=Paramount+ & Epix Expand Strategic Relationship|url=https://deadline.com/2021/02/paramount-epix-expand-strategic-relationship-1234700342/|access-date=March 22, 2021|work=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|archive-date=February 26, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210226004328/https://deadline.com/2021/02/paramount-epix-expand-strategic-relationship-1234700342/|url-status=live}}</ref> ''House of Gucci'' became available for wider streaming on February 1, 2022. It was released on [[Blu-ray]] and [[DVD-Video|DVD]] on February 22.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://variety.com/2022/film/news/house-of-gucci-watch-online-1235151308/|title=''House of Gucci'' Will Be Available to Watch Online in February|date=January 11, 2022|first=Jennifer|last=Yuma|website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|access-date=January 12, 2022|archive-date=January 11, 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220111185744/https://variety.com/2022/film/news/house-of-gucci-watch-online-1235151308/|url-status=live}}</ref>

[[United Artists Releasing]] aired the first trailer for the film during the [[2021 Summer Olympics]]. Social media accounts promoting the film on [[Twitter]], [[Instagram]], [[YouTube]], and [[Facebook]] had a total of 415.4 million followers, including 234 million followers from the cast.

Overall, the marketing campaign delivered at least 1.2 billion impressions and 407 million views online. Marketing tactics included radio, social and ticketing partnerships, television spots, and promotions on [[TikTok]], Twitter and [[Snapchat]]. Crime [[podcast]]s were used to attract younger audiences. In theaters, trailers for the film ran during screenings of ''[[Respect (2021 American film)|Respect]]'', ''[[Free Guy]]'', ''[[Dear Evan Hansen (film)|Dear Evan Hansen]]'', ''[[No Time to Die]]'', ''[[Halloween Kills]]'', ''[[The Last Duel (2021 film)|The Last Duel]]'' and ''[[Eternals (film)|Eternals]]''.<ref name="OpeningSundayUpdate" /> By November 25, [[United Artists Releasing]] had spent $12.8 million on television advertisements promoting the film.<ref name="opening" />

==Reception==
=== Box office ===
''House of Gucci'' grossed $53.8 million in the United States and Canada, and $99.4 million in other territories, for a worldwide total of $153.2 million.<ref name="BOX"/><ref name="NUM">{{Cite The Numbers |id=House-of-Gucci-(2021) |title= House of Gucci (2021) |access-date=March 18, 2022}}{{cbignore}}</ref>

In the United States and Canada, ''House of Gucci'' was released alongside ''[[Encanto]]'' and ''[[Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City]]'', and was originally projected to gross $15-to-20 million from 3,441 theaters in its five-day opening weekend.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=D'Alessandro |first1=Anthony |last2=Tartaglione |first2=Nancy |date=November 23, 2021 |title='Encanto' To Make The Whole World Sing With $70M+ Global Opening – Box Office Preview |url=https://deadline.com/2021/11/encanto-house-of-gucci-thanksgiving-box-office-preview-1234879647/ |access-date=November 23, 2021 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |archive-date=November 23, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211123205514/https://deadline.com/2021/11/encanto-house-of-gucci-thanksgiving-box-office-preview-1234879647/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="OpeningSundayUpdate" />

The film opened nationwide on Wednesday, November 24, 2021, and made $4.2 million on its first day—including $1.3 million from Tuesday night previews—from a total of 345,000 theater admissions. ''House of Gucci'' went on to debut to a $22 million five-day opening.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.boxofficemojo.com/weekend/2021W48/occasion/us_thanksgiving_5/|title=Domestic 2021 Weekend 48: November 24-28, 2021 – Thanksgiving 5-Day weekend (US)|website=[[Box Office Mojo]]|access-date=December 3, 2021|archive-date=December 3, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211203153021/https://www.boxofficemojo.com/weekend/2021W48/occasion/us_thanksgiving_5/|url-status=live}}</ref>

The main reasons given for seeing the film were Lady Gaga (40%), the ensemble cast (32%) and the plot (34%).<ref name="opening">{{cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2021/11/encanto-house-of-gucci-resident-evil-thanksgiving-box-office-1234880192/|title=The Sobering Reality Of Thanksgiving Box Office During Pandemic With 'Encanto' Sans 'Top Gun 2'; Adults Return For 'House Of Gucci', 'Licorice Pizza'|date=November 27, 2021|first=Anthony|last=D'Alessandro|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|access-date=November 28, 2021|archive-date=November 25, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211125222254/https://deadline.com/2021/11/encanto-house-of-gucci-resident-evil-thanksgiving-box-office-1234880192/|url-status=live}}</ref> 45% of audiences were between the ages of 18 and 34, and 34% over the age of 45, a higher-than-average result for a drama film targeting an older audience during the COVID-19 pandemic. According to ''[[Deadline Hollywood]]'', ''House of Gucci'' had the best box-office opening for a drama film since ''[[Little Women (2019 film)|Little Women]]'' in 2019,<ref name="OpeningSundayUpdate">{{cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2021/11/encanto-house-of-gucci-thanksgiving-box-office-weekend-summary-1234881076/|title='Encanto' & 'Ghostbusters: Afterlife' Split Families, 'House Of Gucci' Best Opening For Drama In Two Years – Thanksgiving Box Office, Sunday Update|date=November 28, 2021|first=Anthony|last=D'Alessandro|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|access-date=November 28, 2021|archive-date=November 28, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211128162125/https://deadline.com/2021/11/encanto-house-of-gucci-thanksgiving-box-office-weekend-summary-1234881076/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/box-office-winners-losers-house-of-gucci-1235053651/|title=Box Office: Thanksgiving Winners & Losers from 'House of Gucci' to 'King Richard'|date=November 29, 2021|first=Pamela|last=McClintock|website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]]|access-date=November 29, 2021}}</ref> and ''[[Forbes]]'' predicted that the film would become "by far, the most 'successful' adult-skewing non-action drama of the so-called pandemic era".<ref>{{cite magazine|last=Mendelson|first=Scott|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/scottmendelson/2021/11/27/box-office-house-of-gucci-earns-6m-friday-as-resident-evil-is-doa/?sh=10a86d377abc|title=Box Office: 'House Of Gucci' Earns $5.7M Friday But 'Resident Evil' Is DOA|magazine=[[Forbes]]|date=November 27, 2021|access-date=December 26, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211127172846/https://www.forbes.com/sites/scottmendelson/2021/11/27/box-office-house-of-gucci-earns-6m-friday-as-resident-evil-is-doa/?sh=45d1570f7abc|archive-date=November 27, 2021|url-status=live}}</ref>

The film made $7 million in its second weekend,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://deadline.com/2021/12/weekend-box-office-encanto-spider-man-no-way-home-1234884813/|title=''Encanto'' Leads & ''Ghostbusters: === Critical response ===
On the [[review aggregator]] website [[Rotten Tomatoes]], {{RT data|score}} of {{RT data|count}} critics' reviews are positive, with an average rating of {{RT data|average}}. The website's consensus reads: "''House of Gucci'' vacillates between inspired camp and dour drama too often to pull off a confident runway strut, but Lady Gaga's note-perfect performance has a timeless style all its own."<ref>{{Cite Rotten Tomatoes |id={{RT data|rtid|noprefix=y}} |title=House of Gucci |type=m |access-date={{RT data|access-date}}}}{{RT data|edit}}</ref> [[Metacritic]], which uses a [[weighted average]], assigned the film a score of 60 out of 100 based on 60 critics, indicating "mixed or average" reviews.<ref>{{Cite Metacritic |id=house-of-gucci |title=House of Gucci |type=m |access-date=May 4, 2026}}</ref> Audiences polled by [[CinemaScore]] gave the film an average grade of "B+" on a scale of A+ to F, while those at [[PostTrak]] gave it an 82% positive score, with 60% saying that they would recommend it.

''[[Deadline Hollywood]]'' noted a strong divide between critics and audiences, and said, "It appears moviegoers are overpowering."<ref name="opening" />

''[[Screen Rant]]'' commented that although the film received mixed reviews from critics, the performances of the cast were highly praised, with particular emphasis on Lady Gaga, Al Pacino, and Jared Leto.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Ahmed |first1=Sahil |title=Jared Leto Reveals Why He Related To His House of Gucci Character |url=https://screenrant.com/house-gucci-movie-jared-leto-paolo-relate-why/ |access-date=November 30, 2021 |work=[[Screen Rant]] |date=November 28, 2021 |archive-date=November 30, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211130234902/https://screenrant.com/house-gucci-movie-jared-leto-paolo-relate-why/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Alissa Wilkinson of ''[[Vox (website)|Vox]]'' gave the film a mixed review, praising the performances but criticizing the screenplay and writing. "The movie the trailer is selling is actually a little more dishy and wild than the real ''House of Gucci'', which would be a pointless and somewhat perfunctory dud if it weren't for the brilliance, or madness, of the performances."<ref>{{cite news |first=Alissa |last=Wilkinson |title=What can you even say about House of Gucci? It's stupid. It's perfect. |date=November 22, 2021 |work=[[Vox (website)|Vox]] |access-date=November 22, 2021 |url=https://www.vox.com/22775518/house-gucci-review-gaga |archive-date=October 8, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241008235304/https://www.vox.com/22775518/house-gucci-review-gaga |url-status=live }}</ref>

Reviewing the film for ''[[The Hollywood Reporter]]'', David Rooney wrote, "Ridley Scott's film is a trashtacular watch that I wouldn't have missed for the world. But it fails to settle on a consistent tone — overlong and undisciplined as it careens between high drama and [[opera buffa]]."<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rooney |first1=David |title=Lady Gaga and Adam Driver in Ridley Scott's 'House of Gucci': Film Review |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-reviews/house-of-gucci-lady-gaga-1235049472/ |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |date=November 22, 2021 |access-date=November 22, 2021 |archive-date=December 17, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211217095154/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-reviews/house-of-gucci-lady-gaga-1235049472/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

[[Richard Roeper]] of the ''[[Chicago Sun-Times]]'' gave the film two-and-a-half stars out of four, writing, "Adam Driver (who has now played a French squire and an Italian fashion heir in consecutive Ridley Scott movies) and Lady Gaga have legit chemistry together, and it's still a kick to see Al Pacino roaring like a lion in winter. But Hayek and Irons are playing cardboard-thin characters, Leto flounders about as if he's in a movie all his own, and ''House of Gucci'' feels coldly calculating when it should have been flush and warm with scandalous [[sensationalism]]."<ref>{{cite web |last=Roeper |first=Richard |author-link=Richard Roeper |title=House of Gucci': Stitching together lots of material, prestige murder movie still feels flimsy |url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/movies-and-tv/2021/11/22/22793840/house-of-gucci-review-lady-gaga-movie-adam-driver-jared-leto-al-pacino-maurizio-patrizia |website=[[Chicago Sun-Times]] |date=November 22, 2021 |access-date=November 22, 2021 |archive-date=November 22, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211122235209/https://chicago.suntimes.com/movies-and-tv/2021/11/22/22793840/house-of-gucci-review-lady-gaga-movie-adam-driver-jared-leto-al-pacino-maurizio-patrizia |url-status=live }}</ref>

Writing for ''[[The New York Times]]'', [[A. O. Scott]] found the film to be a missed opportunity that could have been crafted more in line with better cinematic standards, stating that it lacks "the necessary vision or inspiration".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/23/movies/house-of-gucci-review.html|url-access=limited|title='House of Gucci' Review: Murder, Italian-Style|date=November 23, 2021|first=A. O.|last=Scott|author-link=A. O. Scott|website=[[The New York Times]]|access-date=November 30, 2021|archive-date=November 30, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211130002314/https://www.nytimes.com/2021/11/23/movies/house-of-gucci-review.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

Gaga's [[Italian accent]] was met with criticism by Italian actress and [[dialect coach]] Francesca De Martini, who worked on the set as a dialogue coach for Hayek, and claimed that Gaga's "accent is not exactly an Italian accent, it sounds more [[Russian accent|Russian]]".<ref>{{Cite news|last=Roundtree|first=Cheyenne|date=2021-11-14|title='House of Gucci' Dialogue Coach Admits Lady Gaga's Accent Is More Russian Than Italian|language=en|work=[[The Daily Beast]]|url=https://www.thedailybeast.com/house-of-gucci-dialogue-coach-admits-lady-gagas-accent-is-more-russian-than-italian|access-date=2021-11-16|archive-date=November 16, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211116182330/https://www.thedailybeast.com/house-of-gucci-dialogue-coach-admits-lady-gagas-accent-is-more-russian-than-italian|url-status=live}}</ref>

[[BBC]] stated that Leto's portrayal of Paolo Gucci inspired "both ridicule and irritation".<ref>{{Cite news|last=Barber|first=Nicolas|date=2021-11-24|title=House of Gucci and the trouble with extreme actor makeovers|language=en|work=[[BBC]]|url=https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20211123-house-of-gucci-and-the-trouble-with-extreme-actor-makeovers|access-date=2021-12-12|archive-date=December 12, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211212134913/https://www.bbc.com/culture/article/20211123-house-of-gucci-and-the-trouble-with-extreme-actor-makeovers|url-status=live}}</ref> Film critic [[Mark Kermode]] described his performance as "parodic", writing that "while others adopt faintly ridiculous Italian inflections, Leto delivers his lines in a string of high-pitched whoops that suggest he is attempting to communicate with whales".<ref>{{Cite news|last=Kermode|first=Mark|date=2021-11-24|title=House of Gucci review – Lady Gaga steers a steely path through the madness|language=en|work=[[The Guardian]]|url=https://www.theguardian.com/film/2021/nov/28/house-of-gucci-review-ridley-scott-lady-gaga-al-pacino-jared-leto|access-date=2021-12-12}}</ref>

David Ehrlich of ''[[IndieWire]]'' described Leto as "brilliantly over-the-top".<ref>{{Cite news|last=Ehrlich|first=David|date=2021-11-22|title='House of Gucci' Review: Lady Gaga Is a Money Monster for the Ages in Ridley Scott's Muted Satire|language=en|work=[[Indiewire]]|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/house-of-gucci-review-lady-gaga-1234680909/|access-date=2021-12-12|archive-date=December 12, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211212134913/https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/house-of-gucci-review-lady-gaga-1234680909/|url-status=live}}</ref>

Responding to negative reviews characterizing the cast's performances as "high-flown and jarringly incongruous", Michael Shindler of ''[[The American Conservative]]'' wrote that such comments overlook those performances' relation to the film's "dramatic substance", "a conflict of high-flown and jarringly incongruous personalities vying to remake Gucci in their own image", arguing that the film, like Scott's ''[[All the Money in the World]]'', is a [[historical drama]] about the emergence of "a new man whose very character is adapted to the demands of contemporary commerce", comparing [[J. Paul Getty]]'s role in the latter to that of Tom Ford.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Shindler |first1=Michael |title=House for Sale |journal=The American Conservative |date=January 14, 2002 |url=https://www.theamericanconservative.com/articles/house-for-sale/ |access-date=16 January 2022 |archive-date=January 16, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220116010419/https://www.theamericanconservative.com/articles/house-for-sale/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Response from involved parties ===
In January 2021, during an interview with Italian magazine ''[[Novella 2000]]'', the murderer Patrizia Reggiani approved that Gaga would portray her and commented that she "immensely" likes her, saying, "she's a genius".<ref>{{cite web|last=Alessi|first=Roberto|date=January 27, 2021|title=Patrizia Reggiani svela: 'Un film sul caso Gucci, Lady Gaga nel cast'|url=https://www.novella2000.it/patrizia-reggiani-film-gucci-lady-gaga-cast/|language=it|access-date=March 22, 2021|work=[[Novella 2000]]|archive-date=February 25, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210225142322/https://www.novella2000.it/patrizia-reggiani-film-gucci-lady-gaga-cast/|url-status=live}}</ref> However, in March, Reggiani gave an interview to the [[Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata]] (ANSA), in which she stated that she was "annoyed" that Gaga had not contacted her to meet her, and claimed that "it is not an economic question. I won't get a cent from the film. It is a question of good sense and respect."<ref>{{cite web|date=March 11, 2021|title=Gucci 'black widow' miffed by Lady Gaga snub|url=https://www.ansa.it/english/news/lifestyle/arts/2021/03/11/gucci-black-widow-miffed-by-lady-gaga-snub_3a95687b-2439-4fdb-8945-b19d3c067992.html|access-date=March 22, 2021|publisher=[[Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata]]|archive-date=March 16, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210316095540/https://www.ansa.it/english/news/lifestyle/arts/2021/03/11/gucci-black-widow-miffed-by-lady-gaga-snub_3a95687b-2439-4fdb-8945-b19d3c067992.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

Later that month, it was confirmed that the producers did not want Gaga to meet her, and that they were "aware of not wanting to endorse or support the awful crime" that she committed, saying that Gaga had watched much footage and many documentaries, and read books about her life.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Watts |first1=Halina |last2=Roberts |first2=Hannah |date=March 20, 2021 |title=Lady Gaga to leave comfort zone with House of Gucci role as 'Black Widow' socialite |url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-news/lady-gaga-leave-comfort-zone-23765275 |access-date=March 22, 2021 |work=[[Daily Mirror]] |archive-date=March 22, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210322121017/https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-news/lady-gaga-leave-comfort-zone-23765275 |url-status=live}}</ref> Gaga also stated that she has no interest in "colluding" with Reggiani, but that her heart goes "out to her daughters... I do care deeply that this must be very painful for them".<ref>{{cite news |date=November 18, 2021 |title=Lady Gaga says she won't meet Patrizia Reggiani and 'cares deeply' about House of Gucci impact |url=https://www.itv.com/news/2021-11-17/lady-gaga-i-dont-want-to-collude-with-patrizia-gucci |work=[[ITV News]] |access-date=December 2, 2021 |archive-date=December 2, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211202204436/https://www.itv.com/news/2021-11-17/lady-gaga-i-dont-want-to-collude-with-patrizia-gucci |url-status=live}}</ref>

[[Patrizia Gucci]], who is Paolo Gucci's daughter and Maurizio Gucci's first cousin once removed, told the [[Associated Press]], in the name of the Gucci family, that they were "truly disappointed" by the film. "They are stealing the identity of a family to make a profit, to increase the income of the Hollywood system." She added, "Our family has an identity, privacy. We can talk about everything, but there is a borderline that cannot be crossed."

According to Gucci, the three central concerns of the family are inaccuracies in the film, the lack of contact with Ridley Scott, and the casting of high-profile actors to play people who were not connected with the murder. She also said that the Gucci family will decide what their next course of action will be after watching the completed film.<ref>{{cite news|last=Berry|first=Colleen|date=April 15, 2021|title=Gucci heirs worry over family depiction in Ridley Scott film|url=https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/gucci-heirs-worry-family-depiction-ridley-scott-film-77086442|publisher=ABC News|access-date=May 12, 2021|archive-date=May 12, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210512060119/https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/gucci-heirs-worry-family-depiction-ridley-scott-film-77086442|url-status=live}}</ref> Scott rejected her claims, saying, "You have to remember that one Gucci was murdered and another went to jail for tax evasion so you can't be talking to me about making a profit. As soon as you do that you become part of the public domain."<ref>{{Cite web|last=Goldbart|first=Max|title=Ridley Scott Hits Back At Gucci Family Criticism; Reveals Napoleon Biopic 'Kitbag' Filming Date|url=https://deadline.com/2021/11/ridley-scott-hits-back-at-gucci-family-criticism-reveals-napoleon-biopic-kitbag-filming-date-1234878689/|website=[[Deadline Hollywood]]|date=November 22, 2021|access-date=November 22, 2021|archive-date=November 22, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211122093043/https://deadline.com/2021/11/ridley-scott-hits-back-at-gucci-family-criticism-reveals-napoleon-biopic-kitbag-filming-date-1234878689/|url-status=live}}</ref>

[[Tom Ford]], in an article for ''[[Air Mail (magazine)|Air Mail]]'', stated that he "felt as though [he] had lived through a hurricane when [he] left the theater", saying that, despite laughing on a few occasions, he found it "hard for [him] to see the humor and camp in something that was so bloody. In real life, none of it was camp. It was at times absurd, but ultimately it was tragic."

Ford praised most of the cast, although he did criticize Pacino's and Leto's performances, comparing them to ''[[Saturday Night Live]]'' performers, and adding on the latter, "Leto's brilliance as an actor is literally buried under latex prosthetics. Paolo, whom I met on several occasions, was indeed eccentric and did some wacky things, but his overall demeanor was certainly not like the crazed and seemingly mentally challenged character of Leto's performance." While not directly commenting on his role in the film nor Reeve Carney's portrayal of him, Ford noted that the moment of Maurizio's toasting of him was inaccurate, as he had already been bought out by the company before Ford became Gucci's creative director.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Lattanzio|first=Ryan|title=Tom Ford Compares Watching 'House of Gucci' to Surviving a Hurricane: 'Hard to See the Humor and Camp'|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/tom-ford-house-of-gucci-jared-leto-performance-1234681740/|website=[[IndieWire]]|date=November 28, 2021|access-date=December 2, 2021|archive-date=December 2, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211202203856/https://www.indiewire.com/2021/11/tom-ford-house-of-gucci-jared-leto-performance-1234681740/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Ford|first=Tom|title=Tom Ford Does Gucci|url=https://airmail.news/issues/2021-11-27/tom-ford-does-gucci|website=[[Air Mail (magazine)|Air Mail]]|date=November 27, 2021|access-date=December 2, 2021|archive-date=December 1, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211201223812/https://airmail.news/issues/2021-11-27/tom-ford-does-gucci|url-status=live}}</ref>
